categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determination of land ownership under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific details about land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and land classifications. The content focuses entirely on land settlement and property registration matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related administrative determinations.
